full_judgment:
6. By the judgment and decree dated 14.08.2012 the High Court Division decreed the admiralty suit awarding to the plaintiff a sum of US $ 1,750,000.00. The Marshal of the Court was directed to encash the bank Guarantee bearing No. 999TS342LG06 dated 05.11.2006 issued by Eastern Bank Limited. 

 24. Civil Miscellaneous Petition No.271 of 2017 has been filed challenging an order of the High Court Division dated 31.01.2017 directing the Marshal of the High Court Division to encash the Bank guarantee furnished in Admiralty Suit No.24 of 2005 and to transmit the proceeds to the bank account of the plaintiff decree holder overseas. In view of the dismissal of Civil Review Petition No.316 of 2016 there is no merit in the civil miscellaneous petition, which is accordingly dismissed.
